hook: HYDRAA turns to Hyderabad's *160+* stepwells after lakes
hook_b: HYDRAA turns to Hyderabad's *160+* stepwells after lakes
tldr: HYDRAA Commissioner A. Ranganath said the SOPs written for lake conservation will now be used to restore stepwells in Telangana, and the idea may go national.

beats.what: Ranganath announced it at a stepwell awareness programme in Hyderabad, where Akarma Foundation showed an exhibition on Telangana's water legacy.
beats.why: He linked it to the El Nino water crisis: stepwells are more decentralised than lakes and restoring them should help the groundwater table.
beats.care: He will raise stepwell conservation at a meeting with the Union Home Secretary next Tuesday on Hyderabad water, floods and drought.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Ranganath said many lakes near temples and stepwells have disappeared altogether.

qs: How many of Hyderabad's stepwells still hold water today?
Will lake encroachment rules also apply to land around stepwells?

facts.t: Telangana has *more than 600* stepwells, HYDRAA's chief said, and the number is likely higher.

viz.l: Hyderabad's share of Telangana's known stepwells
viz.verdict: Hyderabad holds about a quarter of the state's known stepwells; real count likely higher

learn.t: SOP = standard operating procedure, a fixed step-by-step rulebook

watch: What comes out of Tuesday's meeting with the Union Home Secretary on water, floods and drought.
